description.value: Bayleaf Indian Fusion is a family-run restaurant located inside the Fernie Golf Club, operated by Chef and Owner Dilip Chand whose culinary background spans Nepal, India, and working for the Sheikh of Bahrain. The menu blends Indian, Nepalese, and Hakka dishes with a full Western menu, and features a full-service bar with BC craft beers including Fernie Brewing Co. drafts. The restaurant also offers catering and online ordering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and provides strong evidence. The restaurant is located at 201 Fairway Dr, Fernie, BC V0B 1M5 (confirmed from footer on multiple subpages), phone 250-423-4115 (confirmed from front page), and the website URL matches the OSM record. The menu shows extensive vegetarian options (Navaratna Korma, Cheesy Kofta, Cauli Aloo, Aubergine Bharta, Paneer dishes, Ultimate Veggie Burger, Ultimate Veggies wrap) and an online ordering option. No explicit mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging was found in the website content.
